title: aureolaria grandiflora subsp. cinerea
intro: Aureolaria grandiflora subsp. cinerea, commonly known as Grey-stemmed Penstemon, is a plant species belonging to the plantain family (Plantaginaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Grey-stemmed Penstemon include antispasmodic and expectorant effects, making it a potential remedy for treating coughs and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties are yet to be fully identified, but it is known to contain flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other bioactive compounds.
